Optional hardware firmware is not included (licence).
This image carries no vendor firmware: it is not ours to hand out under one licence. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and the graphics chips of AMD,
NVIDIA and newer Intel computers may need such files. Ethernet, the keyboard, mouse, storage and the sound codecs work without them, and
the screen works on the firmware's own graphics mode.
Install what THIS computer needs: Store -> Setup -> Hardware firmware (needs the internet: Ethernet, a cable to another computer that
shares its connection, or a USB stick prepared on another computer). You read each vendor licence and click first. Nothing is
downloaded before that.
